items.text: Videos received by Iran International show a group of students in the Motekhasesin neighborhood of Kermanshah city on Saturday, 30 Aban, came to the streets and shouted "Sogand Sayadi." According to reports, government forces beat them.

Today, Sunday, a number of Social Security and cultural retirees gathered in front of the Social Security Organization building in Tehran. In addition to their labor demands, the retirees chanted protest slogans and held placards demanding the halt of death sentences and the release of imprisoned teachers.

It was reported that in less than 48 hours, the price of macaroni increased by 100%, Iran Khodro products up to one billion tomans, tires by 30%, dairy products by 15%, and transportation costs by 22%. Reports from Mazandaran, Rasht, Gilan, and Isfahan describe problems such as expensive bread, power outages, lack of gas, rising prices of soda and food items, and cuts in subsidies. A retiree from Isfahan said his 20 million toman salary after 30 years of work is insufficient and his ration card and subsidies have been cut.

According to videos received by Iran International, a group of students in the Motekhassesin neighborhood of Kermanshah city came to the streets on Saturday, 30 Aban, shouting "Sogand Sayadi." According to reports, government forces beat them.

The head of the Cancer Management Group at the Ministry of Health announced that about 142,000 new cancer cases are registered annually in Iran, with men constituting more than half of these cases. Beheshtian identified tobacco, unhealthy diet, and physical inactivity as risk factors and emphasized early screening if there is a family history.

Zelensky requested the United States to authorize the transfer of Patriot missile interceptors, the cost of which was previously paid by Ukraine's allies. This request was made after a Russian drone attack on a five-story residential building in the city of Dymer.

Narges Mohammadi, Nobel Peace Prize laureate, reacted to the transfer of Milad Armoon and Navid Najaran, two political prisoners sentenced to death in the Ekbatan case, to solitary confinement in Qezel Hesar prison in Karaj and called to prevent the execution of their death sentences. Mohammadi stated that the death sentences had previously been overturned by the criminal court, but Branch 15 of the Revolutionary Court, headed by Abolghasem Salavati, sentenced them to death again. She also said Armoon and Najaran were tried in closed courts without adherence to even the laws of the Islamic Republic.

European Union member countries opposed the approval of the final agreement of the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31). The closing session of this conference began on Sunday in Antalya, Turkey, after hours of negotiations among country representatives. Due to disagreements among countries and prolonged negotiations, the conference lasted 44 hours longer than scheduled, breaking the record for the longest UN climate meeting.

The water of the Dirmendere River passing through the center of Rize in northeastern Turkey suddenly turned red, shocking residents. Local authorities identified a private tea factory as the source of pollution using a drone, which discharged untreated wastewater directly into the river. The factory has been fined and water samples have been sent to a laboratory for examination.

Juventus defeated Venezia 4-0 in the twelfth week of Italy's Serie A with four goals in the second half. Nic Voltemade, Ton Koopmeiners, Juan Cuadrado, and Randal Kolo Muani were the goal scorers for Juventus. Kolo Muani converted a penalty that he himself had won into a goal.
A video received by Iran International shows protesters in Shahroud writing the slogan "Long live the Shah" on the wall opposite the Industrial University.

According to information received by Iran International, a number of students were arrested during the gathering on Saturday, 30 Aban in Kermanshah, protesting the killing of Sogand Sayadi. During this gathering, slogans including "Death to the dictator" were chanted.

In continuation of the Social Security retirees' protests, today, Sunday, 1 Azar, a group of them gathered in front of the Social Security building in Rasht. The retirees demanded a salary increase in line with inflation and living costs, as well as attention to their medical and supplementary insurance issues. They also held placards and chanted slogans demanding the release of teachers and political prisoners.

Milad Armoon and Navid Najaran, two prisoners sentenced to death in the "Ekbatān Town" case and detainees of the 1401 nationwide protests, were transferred to solitary confinement in Qezelhesar Prison in Karaj. Their death sentences were confirmed by the Supreme Court. They were moved to Suite 35, Unit 3 of Qezelhesar Prison.

According to videos received by Iran International, a group of students in Kermanshah took to the streets on Saturday, 30 Aban, protesting against the principal of Rezvan High School where "Sogand Sayadi" studies. According to reports, government forces beat them.

Javad Nekounam, head coach of Tractor, said in a press conference before the match against Al Wasl UAE that his team must enter the field with high focus and full mental readiness. He emphasized that the game is tough and the smarter team has a better chance for the desired result. Nekounam also mentioned the difficulties in reaching this stage and said every match is like a final for the team.

The Israeli army confirmed that it has joint plans with the US for a scenario of attack and resumption of war with Iran, and estimates that the time for Donald Trump's decision on action against Iran is near.
A citizen sent a video to Iran International reporting a 66% increase in hamburger prices over six months: "It has risen from 475,400 tomans in Esfand 1404 to 790,000 tomans in Mehr 1405."
